calibration.bucket_status: posthoc descriptive calibration diagnostics; no conditional-coverage guarantee or replacement calibration

diagnosis.sensitivity_limit: Only predicted input geometry changes. No target accuracy, coverage, optimum retention, or feasible-hit rate is evaluated. Zero radii mean point predictions, not known truths.

statistic_conventions.median: middle value or exact mean of the two middle values
statistic_conventions.p90_p95_p99: nearest-rank empirical order statistic ceil(n*p), descriptive only
statistic_conventions.possibility_margin: formation_radius - predicted_formation; nonnegative is possibly feasible
statistic_conventions.strict_pruning_margin: score_lower - best_certified_score_upper; positive excludes, zero retains
